module: Editor tool "Vehicle Groups Manager" (Gameplay menu) to create, edit, load and save vehicle groups (.vehGroup.json files) and make them spawn in the world via core_multiSpawn. A group is of type "custom" (hand-picked list of vehicles: model, config, paints) or "generator" (parameters: amount, allMods, allConfigs, minPop, modelPopPower, configPopPower, popDecreaseFactor, maxYear, with which core_multiSpawn.createGroup generates the vehicles). The groups found in vehicleGroups/ and settings/editor/vehicleGroups/ are loaded automatically on first display.
notes: Spawn modes offered: road, traffic, lineAhead/Behind/Left/Right/Above, raceGrid, raceGridAlt.

On save, the group is cleaned: "custom" groups lose generator, vehicles without a model are removed, paint tables are only kept if the paint is "(Custom)"; generator groups lose data. The old type "locked" is converted to "generator".
saveGroup ignores its first parameter (file); only filePath is used. It assumes that options.groupListIdx designates an existing group in the list.
The "Delete" button calls core_multiSpawn.deleteVehicles(amount); "Set Scene Vehicles to Group" replaces the group's data with core_multiSpawn.spawnedVehsToGroup().
The spawn state (spawnState) goes back to 0 when core_multiSpawn emits onVehicleGroupSpawned (hook called with vehIds, groupId, name).

filePaths.desc: Folders explored to automatically load the groups: {"vehicleGroups/", "settings/editor/vehicleGroups/"}. Modifiable before the tool's first display.

loadGroup.desc: Reads a .vehGroup.json file, makes it the current group (after cleaning), selects its first vehicle and adds it to the groups list if it is not already there. Writes a warning to the log if the read fails.

saveGroup.desc: Writes the current group (processed by processGroup) to a JSON file and remembers the folder and the file path.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the "Vehicle Groups Manager" window (File and Tools menus, groups list, group editing, spawn options).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the main window and three modal windows (generator, custom paint, group replacement) and the "Gameplay" menu entry.

onVehicleGroupSpawned.desc: Hook emitted by core_multiSpawn once the group has spawned; sets spawnState back to 0 (makes "Please wait..." disappear).

onWindowMenuItem.desc: Menu entry handler: initializes the tables if needed, clears the editor's object selection and shows the window.
